data.body: Implementation committed at da43a4e98a2f2bb8effdbab188769c7541c4b060. Only the three reviewed module docstrings changed. They now retain the bare support-module import constraint, structural Jira mutation guard, three opt-in layers, isolated S3 prefix lifecycle, and all seven scenario responsibilities without repeated history or assertion narration. The normalized non-docstring AST and exact directive inventory, comment hygiene, scoped Ruff and formatting, seven-test focused collection, path-scoped diff integrity, pre-commit repository lint and typecheck, and commit-ticket validation all passed. Per operator direction, full make verify is deferred to Gerrit CI. The leaf awaits its independent three-row receipt and Gerrit availability. It has not been pushed or closed.
